ADC_UTIL

Provides data types, constants and generic helper functions for ADC.

Author

Juergen Sieben, ConDeS GmbH

Public types
Package types
ora_name_type

Varchar2 with the same length as an Oracle name (varying between 30 byte in Oracle until version 11 and 128 byte starting with version 12)

sql_char

Max length of a sql varchar2.

max_char

Max length of a PL/SQL varchar2

flag_type

Persistable representation of a boolean flag. May be defined upon installation of ADC.

environment_rec

Record that defines environmental information about the actually executed rule Is used in adc_validation for checks against the meta data of ADC

Properties
crg_id

ID of the rule group actually in use

app_id

APEX application ID

page_id

APEX application page ID

get_boolean
function get_boolean(
p_bool 
in varchar2
)
return adc_util.flag_type

Helper to map different boolean values to TRUE or FALSE.  Is used to map "TRUTHY" values to true and "FALSY" value to false.  Used to stabilize im- and export of meta data between versions of ADC

Boolean value that is to be converted

Returns: adc_util.C_TRUE | adc_util.C_TRUE

bulk_replace
function bulk_replace(
p_text 
in varchar2,
p_string_table 
in string_table
)
return varchar2

Minimalistic bulk replace-Method. Replaces odd entries as anchors in p_string with their following even entries of p_string_table.  This method supports a pipe-enhanced syntax within the anchors as follows:

#ANCHOR|PREFIX_IF_NOT_NULL|POSTFIX_IF_NOT_NULL|NULL_VALUE#

As an example, anchor ABC is surrounded with brackets, if the replacement is not null and skipped otherwise:

#ABC|(|)|#

Parameter
p_text
in varchar2

Text with the replacement anchors

p_string_table
in string_table

Table of varchar2 snippets.

Returns

Replaced text

clean_adc_name
function clean_adc_name(
p_name 
in varchar2
)
return varchar2

Helper to sanitize any ADC name to comply with internal naming rules Name that adheres to the following naming conventions: - no quotes - no blanks (replaced by underscores) - all uppercase - length limit 50

Parameter
p_name
in varchar2

Name to sanitize

Returns

sanitized name

monitor_loop
procedure monitor_loop(
p_counter 
in number
 default 
null,
p_loop_name 
in varchar2
 default 
null
)

Method to monitor that loops can't go into infinite loop mode.  If the parameters are NULL, a new monitor is instantiated. Within the loop this method is called with a variable holding the amount of loops so far The method increments this variable and checks it against the maximally allowed loop operations. If it exceeds this limit, an exception is thrown

Parameters
p_counter
in number

Optional variable that holds the amount of loops

p_loop_name
in varchar2

Optional name of the the loop to monitor

get_additional_nd_comments
function get_additional_nd_comments
return clob

Method collects additional comments in NaturalDocs syntax and returns them as CLOB. The content of the comments describes tables and views and picks up their comments and column names.

Add the resulting comments to a sql file that is not executed or commented out to make these available for NaturalDocs.
